result.description: A fictional compact portable solid-state drive designed for everyday file transfers, school projects, and travel backups. The NovaPetal emphasizes a lightweight shell, quiet operation, and fast USB 3.2 Gen 2 connectivity for laptops, tablets, and game consoles. Its teal casing and rounded profile give it a distinct consumer-friendly look, while the 240GB capacity keeps it suited to lightweight storage rather than enterprise workloads.
result.title: NovaPetal 240GB Portable SSD USB 3.2 Gen 2 Teal
